newsitem.title: UK: UK's utility shares are safe haven in lower market. [CORRECTED 14:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: UK's utility shares are safe haven in lower market. [CORRECTED 14:15 GMT]

text.p: Britain's utility shares bucked the market downtrend on the London Stock Exchange, emerging as a safe haven as the investors nervously awaited Wall Street's opening.

Among utility blue chips, United Utilities Plc firmed two pence to 707-1/2 pence and gas supplier Centrica firmed a quarter penny to 88 pence, while gas distributor BG Plc was unchanged at 255 (corrects from 592-1/2).
Analysts said the current market jitters highlighted the attractions of the steady dividend and earnings streams form the utilities.
"When there is a market correction people look at the utilities where there are high yields," said one industry watcher.
